papers.title: Microstructural refinement of TIG weld metal in Ti-6Al-4V alloy through heat treatment at 1000°C

llm.relevance_to_user: 与AM Ti-6Al-4V后处理无关，涉及焊接而非增材制造
llm.why_not_core: This paper studies heat treatment of TIG weld metal, not additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V; it belongs to welding metallurgy, not AM post-processing.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究焊后热处理对Ti-6Al-4V合金TIG焊缝组织的影响
summary_zh.method: 对Ti-6Al-4V TIG焊缝进行1000°C热处理
summary_zh.result: 热处理后焊缝组织得到细化

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of post-weld heat treatment on the microstructure of Ti-6Al-4V TIG weld metal.
summary_en.method: Heat treatment at 1000°C was applied to Ti-6Al-4V TIG weld specimens.
summary_en.result: The microstructure of the weld metal was refined after heat treatment.

papers.title: Study on the influence of multi-direction isothermal forging and warm rolling processes on the microstructure, mechanical properties, and deformation mechanism of Ti-6Al-4V alloy

corresponding_authors.affiliation: Faculty of Metallurgy and Energy Engineering, Kunming University of Science and Technology, Kunming 650093, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及传统锻造和轧制工艺，而非增材制造，与方向要求的增材制造Ti-6Al-4V无关
llm.why_not_core: This paper studies multi-direction isothermal forging and warm rolling processes, which are conventional manufacturing methods, not additive manufacturing; it does not address AM-specific mechanical or fatigue performance of Ti-6Al-4V

summary_zh.motivation: 研究多向等温锻造和温轧对Ti-6Al-4V合金组织和性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 采用多向等温锻造和温轧工艺处理Ti-6Al-4V合金
summary_zh.result: 获得了不同工艺下的微观组织和力学性能变化规律
summary_zh.validation: 通过力学测试和显微观察验证了工艺效果

summary_en.motivation: This study aims to investigate the influence of multi-direction isothermal forging and warm rolling on the microstructure, mechanical properties, and deformation mechanism of Ti-6Al-4V alloy.
summary_en.method: Multi-direction isothermal forging and warm rolling processes were applied to Ti-6Al-4V alloy samples.
summary_en.result: The evolution of microstructure and mechanical properties under different processing conditions was characterized.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing and microstructural analysis were performed to validate the effects of the processes.
